entities.name: Stormcage Containment Facility
entities.description: Prison on an unknown planet where a storm perpetually raged.

entities.name: River Song
entities.description: Notable prisoner and frequent escapee of the Stormcage.

entities.name: The Silence
entities.description: Group River tried to convince that she killed the Doctor.

entities.name: The Doctor
entities.description: Erased all knowledge of himself from every database.

events.summary: River Song was eventually pardoned and released after the Doctor erased all knowledge of himself from every database.
events.quote: River was eventually pardoned and released after the Doctor erased all knowledge of himself from every database in the universe
